content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Billboards, rural broadband and insurance brokerage; Lee's newspapers, news subscriptions and printing do not match."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Online automotive marketplace and dealer software; no newspaper, news subscription or printing business."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Outdoor billboards, transit and street furniture displays; no publishing or subscription news business."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"National lifestyle and health websites and magazines driven by affiliate commerce; not local newspapers or news subscriptions."},{"label":"C5","good":true,"reason":"Owns regional newspapers and digital news subscriptions sold alongside advertising, the core of Lee's model, though it also has books and property portals."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Rural broadband, telephone and video services regulated as telecom; no newspaper or advertising business."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Advertising agency and media buying services paid by fees; Lee sells its own newspapers and audiences."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Fiber internet, telephone and video services over its own network; no publishing or advertising sales."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Marketing agency and public relations services billed as fees; Lee owns and prints its own news media."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"National sports and lifestyle magazines and websites funded by affiliate commerce; not local daily or weekly newspapers."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Radio stations and cable television selling airtime to advertisers; no newspaper, subscription or printing business."}]}
